Definition: from G2596 and the base of G2980; talkative against, i.e. a slanderer:--backbiter.
BiblicalUsage: Backbiters are named among those who hate God, who invent evil things and disobey their parents.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God puts the backbiter in hard company, and that should make me guard my tongue.
